title: Why breakouts love the jawline
body: Hormonal shifts can overstimulate oil glands along the jaw and chin. A gentle salicylic-acid cleanser plus a light, non-comedogenic moisturizer is the classic first line — your expert will confirm what fits your skin.

title: Dryness is often a barrier problem
body: Tightness after cleansing usually means the moisture barrier is stripped. Cream cleansers, ceramides and hyaluronic acid on damp skin help rebuild it within days.
ingredient: Look for: ceramides, hyaluronic acid, squalane

title: Dark spots fade — slowly
body: Post-inflammatory marks can take 6-12 weeks to fade. Daily sunscreen is non-negotiable: without it, brightening actives like vitamin C and azelaic acid cannot win.
ingredient: Look for: vitamin C, azelaic acid, SPF 30+

title: Less is more for reactive skin
body: Redness-prone skin does best with fragrance-free formulas and one active at a time. Patch-test anything new behind the ear for 48 hours.
ingredient: Look for: fragrance-free, centella, oat extract

title: Tone evens with consistency
body: Uneven tone responds to steady exfoliation (1-2x weekly) plus niacinamide. Results build over a month — your check-in tracks the change.
ingredient: Look for: niacinamide, lactic acid, SPF 30+

title: Prevention beats correction
body: Fine lines soften fastest with sunscreen, retinoids introduced slowly, and peptides for firmness. Your expert will stage these so your skin never feels overwhelmed.
